require 'json'
root = File.dirname(__dir__)
state = File.join(root, 'resources.json')
entries = File.exist?(state) ? JSON.parse(File.read(state)) : []
kind, operation = ARGV
case operation
when 'ls'
  puts entries.select { |entry| entry['kind'] == kind }.map { |entry| entry.fetch('Id') }
when 'inspect'
  puts JSON.generate(entries.select { |entry| ARGV.drop(2).include?(entry['Id']) })
when 'rm'
  exit 1 if kind == 'container' && File.read(File.join(root, 'fake-mode')) == 'cleanup-error'
  ids = ARGV.drop(2).reject { |value| value.start_with?('-') }
  File.open(File.join(root, 'removed.jsonl'), 'a') { |file| file.puts(JSON.generate(ids)) }
  File.write(state, JSON.generate(entries.reject { |entry| ids.include?(entry['Id']) }))
end
